body.objective: Construct or obstruct the action-derived replacement 112-row Berger unary theory selected by the exact failure of every local 108-to-112 chain embedding.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_GLOBAL_ROD_TWO_DIRECTION_EXTENSION_OBSTRUCTION and its payload by content hash, together with the terminal dynamical-apparatus parent.  Treat the certified eight-rod action, stress, background K orbit and Phi2 primitives as a replacement theory, not an extension of the old 108-row complex.  Re-derive every metric, clock, Maxwell, rod, multiplier, ghost and cotangent row from the complete changed action; export the full 112-row q1, odd pairing, real involution, K_Berger action, support and zero-mode sectors.  Verify q1^2=0, cyclicity, real compatibility, [K_Berger,q1]=0, background quotient closure and exact row completeness with a method-distinct action variation.  Construct a comparison span or cofiber to the old 108-row theory only if it is support-local and typed; otherwise retain NO_LOCAL_CHAIN_MAP without blocking the replacement theory itself.  Prove minimality against removal of either new rod/cotangent pair.
body.current_gate: complete action-derived replacement 112-row unary complex with no false 108-row embedding
body.forbid: no canonical inclusion repaired by 1/s; no nonlocal comparison called a local chain map; no reuse of old rows where the changed action supplies mixed Hessians; no q2/q3, cohomology, apparatus union, memory, redshift or quantum promotion before unary identities pass
activates: or a complete replacement-theory obstruction and its smallest next enlargement
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER REPLACEMENT-THEORY LANE.  Accept the exact order-minus-one separator and rebuild the changed action's unary complex instead of forcing an impossible extension.
notes: The obstruction certificate is a required scientific input even though it is terminal OBSTRUCTED in the coordination graph.
